name: Log4Shell (Apache Log4j RCE)
vulnerability: Untrusted JNDI lookup allows remote code execution via malicious LDAP server.
fix_description: Disable JNDI lookups to prevent remote code execution

name: Undici Node.js Fetch RCE
vulnerability: Unsafe regex in header parsing leads to denial of service or remote code execution.
fix_description: Validate and sanitize incoming headers to prevent malicious input processing

name: Spring Framework RFD
vulnerability: Multipart request handling allows bypass of request validation.
fix_description: Validate content type and restrict allowed file formats

name: simple-git RCE
vulnerability: Protocol override allows execution of arbitrary commands.
fix_description: Restrict allowed protocols and sanitize repository URLs

name: curl NTLM Auth Info Leak
vulnerability: Double-free vulnerability exposes sensitive authentication data.
fix_description: Implement proper memory handling and state checks

name: Zoho ManageEngine RCE
vulnerability: Improper parsing of properties files leads to remote code execution.
fix_description: Restrict allowed configuration keys and validate input sources

name: Go net/http Auth Bypass
vulnerability: Missing header validation allows authentication bypass.
fix_description: Enforce strict header validation for authenticated endpoints

name: Apache Struts RCE
vulnerability: OGNL injection allows execution of malicious expressions.
fix_description: Validate and sanitize user input to block expression injection

name: Jenkins SSRF
vulnerability: Improper URL validation allows server-side request forgery.
fix_description: Restrict outbound requests using URL allowlisting

name: Spring Cloud Function RCE
vulnerability: Unrestricted expression evaluation leads to remote code execution.
fix_description: Disable unsafe expression parsing or restrict execution contexts
